instruction: The Android Camera album contains `asset_tag_photo.jpg`. Inspect the image and its visible file details to identify the asset id, shelf location, and exact photo filename. Enter those three values in `/home/user/upload/form.html` in Linux Chrome and submit the asset record.
surfaces: Android Simple Gallery Pro Camera album + Linux Chrome asset form
fixture_notes: The phone photo visibly contains AT-4172 and NORTH SHELF in an ordinary Gallery view; its filename is available from Gallery details.
The Linux form has exactly three text fields and never requests Android-to-Linux JPEG transfer.
The host receipt is run-scoped and validates asset id, semantic north-shelf wording, and exact filename.
